definition:
CREATE TABLE access_grants (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	grant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32), 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	principal_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	principal_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	valid_from DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	valid_until DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, grant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, policy_id, principal_type, principal_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, policy_id) REFERENCES policies (tenant_id, policy_id), 
	CHECK (principal_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'service'))
)
name: access_grants

definition:
CREATE TABLE agents (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'offline')), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, agent_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)
name: agents

definition:
CREATE TABLE attempts (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT DEFAULT 'started' NOT NULL, 
	error_code TEXT, 
	started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('started', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'timed_out')), 
	CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, command_id, attempt_number), 
	CHECK (attempt_number > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, command_id) REFERENCES commands (tenant_id, command_id)
)
name: attempts

definition:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	audit_event_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor_id CHAR(32), 
	purpose TEXT NOT NULL, 
	action TEXT NOT NULL, 
	subject_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	subject_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	outcome TEXT NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, audit_event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (outcome IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'failed')), 
	CHECK (actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'service', 'system'))
)
name: audit_events

definition:
CREATE TABLE commands (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id CHAR(32), 
	idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices (tenant_id, device_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'dispatched', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	CHECK (deadline_at >= created_at)
)
name: commands

CREATE TABLE connector_bindings (
	tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	connector_instance_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connection_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	runtime_generation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	accepted_control BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	next_connector_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	next_cloud_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	connected_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, device_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, connection_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('active', 'offline'))
)
name: connector_bindings

definition:
CREATE TABLE control_commands (
	tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_message_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	connector_instance_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	client_instance_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider TEXT NOT NULL, 
	principal_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	profile TEXT NOT NULL, 
	runtime_session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	runtime_generation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	client_request_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	client_turn_id TEXT, 
	method TEXT NOT NULL, 
	params JSON NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	error JSON, 
	issued_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	dispatch_connection_id VARCHAR(36), 
	dispatch_sequence BIGINT, 
	delivery_sent_at DATETIME, 
	dispatched_at DATETIME, 
	receipt_message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	receipt_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	delivered_at DATETIME, 
	result_message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	result_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, command_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'dispatched', 'delivered', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'unknown', 'expired')), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, receipt_message_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, delivery_message_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, provider, principal_id, client_instance_id, session_key, profile, method, client_request_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, result_message_id), 
	CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CHECK (expires_at > issued_at)
)
name: control_commands

definition:
CREATE TABLE device_authentication_challenges (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	challenge_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_mutation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	challenge_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	proof_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	issued_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, challenge_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pairing_mutation_id) REFERENCES pairing_idempotency_records (pairing_mutation_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, credential_id) REFERENCES device_credentials (tenant_id, credential_id), 
	CHECK (expires_at > issued_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices (tenant_id, device_id), 
	CHECK (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= issued_at), 
	CHECK (revision BETWEEN 0 AND 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK ((proof_digest IS NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revision = 0) OR (proof_digest IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND revision = 1)), 
	UNIQUE (pairing_mutation_id)
)
name: device_authentication_challenges

CREATE TABLE device_credential_public_keys (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, 
	public_key BLOB NOT NULL, 
	credential_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, credential_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, credential_fingerprint), 
	CHECK (algorithm = 'ed25519'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, credential_id) REFERENCES device_credentials (tenant_id, credential_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)
name: device_credential_public_keys

definition:
CREATE TABLE device_credentials (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	credential_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	key_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	credential_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	issued_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, credential_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices (tenant_id, device_id), 
	CHECK (credential_type IN ('public_key', 'certificate')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > issued_at), 
	CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= issued_at), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'revoked', 'expired')), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, key_id)
)
name: device_credentials

definition:
CREATE TABLE device_lifecycles (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices (tenant_id, device_id), 
	CHECK (revision >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'revoked', 'retired')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (tenant_id, workspace_id)
)
name: device_lifecycles

CREATE TABLE devices (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, device_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, device_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'offline')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)

CREATE TABLE memberships (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	publish_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	available_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	published_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, event_id),

definition:
CREATE TABLE pairing_claim_limits (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	window_started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	window_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, owner_user_id), 
	CHECK (window_expires_at > window_started_at), 
	CHECK (updated_at >= window_started_at), 
	CHECK (failed_attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 5), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (tenant_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)
name: pairing_claim_limits

definition:
CREATE TABLE pairing_enrollment_proofs (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_offer_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	claim_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scopes JSON NOT NULL, 
	challenge_id CHAR(32), 
	challenge_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	challenge_expires_at DATETIME, 
	owner_confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	confirmation_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, pairing_session_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, pairing_offer_id), 
	CHECK (revision BETWEEN 1 AND 4), 
	CHECK ((challenge_id IS NULL AND challenge_digest IS NULL AND challenge_expires_at IS NULL AND owner_confirmed_at IS NULL) OR (challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND challenge_digest IS NOT NULL AND challenge_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND owner_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (tenant_id, user_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, claim_id), 
	CHECK (challenge_expires_at IS NULL OR challenge_expires_at > owner_confirmed_at), 
	CHECK (confirmation_digest IS NULL OR challenge_digest IS NOT NULL), 
	CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pairing_offer_id) REFERENCES pairing_offers (pairing_offer_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, pairing_session_id) REFERENCES pairing_sessions (tenant_id, pairing_session_id)
)
name: pairing_enrollment_proofs

definition:
CREATE TABLE pairing_idempotency_records (
	pairing_mutation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_offer_id CHAR(32), 
	operation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	principal_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	result_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	retry_after_seconds INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (pairing_mutation_id), 
	CHECK (expected_revision >= 0), 
	CHECK (result_state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'confirmed', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'active', 'suspended', 'revoked', 'retired')), 
	CHECK (retry_after_seconds IS NULL OR retry_after_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 300), 
	CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pairing_offer_id) REFERENCES pairing_offers (pairing_offer_id), 
	CHECK (result_revision >= 0), 
	CHECK (result_code IN ('OK', 'PAIRING_INVALID_REQUEST', 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'FORBIDDEN', 'PAIRING_NOT_FOUND', 'PAIRING_STATE_CONFLICT', 'PAIRING_EXPIRED', 'CHALLENGE_EXPIRED', 'CHALLENGE_INVALID', 'CHALLENGE_REPLAYED', 'DEVICE_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'PAIRING_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE', 'PAIRING_CLAIM_RATE_LIMITED')), 
	CHECK ((result_code = 'PAIRING_CLAIM_RATE_LIMITED' AND retry_after_seconds IS NOT NULL) OR (result_code <> 'PAIRING_CLAIM_RATE_LIMITED' AND retry_after_seconds IS NULL)), 
	UNIQUE (operation, idempotency_key_digest, principal_digest), 
	CHECK (operation IN ('create', 'claim', 'confirm', 'proof', 'cancel', 'revoke', 'device_challenge', 'device_token'))
)
name: pairing_idempotency_records

definition:
CREATE TABLE pairing_offers (
	pairing_offer_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_code_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	bootstrap_secret_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	public_key_algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, 
	public_key BLOB NOT NULL, 
	credential_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	connector_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (pairing_offer_id), 
	UNIQUE (pairing_code_digest), 
	CHECK (pairing_code_digest <> bootstrap_secret_digest), 
	CHECK (public_key_algorithm = 'ed25519'), 
	CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'expired', 'cancelled')), 
	CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	CHECK (revision BETWEEN 0 AND 1), 
	CHECK (claimed_at IS NULL OR claimed_at >= created_at), 
	UNIQUE (bootstrap_secret_digest)
)
name: pairing_offers

definition:
CREATE TABLE pairing_sessions (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id CHAR(32), 
	pairing_code_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	failed_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at DATETIME, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, pairing_session_id), 
	CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	CHECK (confirmed_at IS NULL OR confirmed_at >= claimed_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices (tenant_id, device_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, pairing_code_digest), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	CHECK (failed_attempts >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (tenant_id, workspace_id), 
	CHECK (claimed_at IS NULL OR claimed_at >= created_at), 
	CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'confirmed', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
)
name: pairing_sessions

CREATE TABLE password_credentials (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,

	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE policies (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32), 
	policy_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	effect TEXT NOT NULL, 
	action_pattern TEXT NOT NULL, 
	resource_pattern TEXT NOT NULL, 
	conditions JSON NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, policy_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (version > 0), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, policy_key, version), 
	CHECK (effect IN ('allow', 'deny'))

CREATE TABLE refresh_sessions (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	refresh_session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	rotation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	rotated_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	retention_until DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, refresh_session_id), 
	CHECK (rotated_at IS NULL OR rotated_at >= created_at), 
	CHECK (retention_until >= expires_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (rotation >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, token_digest), 
	CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES users (tenant_id, user_id)
)
name: refresh_sessions

CREATE TABLE roles (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scope_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, role_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, role_key, version), 
	CHECK (scope_type IN ('tenant', 'workspace')), 
	CHECK (version > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled'))
)

CREATE TABLE session_cursors (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	stream TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, session_id, stream), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, session_id) REFERENCES sessions (tenant_id, session_id), 
	CHECK (stream IN ('messages', 'events')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (last_sequence >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, session_id, stream)
)

CREATE TABLE session_events (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	event_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	retention_until DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, session_id, event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, session_id) REFERENCES sessions (tenant_id, session_id),

CREATE TABLE session_messages (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	message_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	role TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content JSON NOT NULL, 
	parent_message_id CHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	retention_until DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, session_id, message_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, session_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, session_id) REFERENCES sessions (tenant_id, session_id), 
	CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	CHECK (retention_until >= created_at), 
	CHECK (role IN ('system', 'user', 'assistant', 'tool'))
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_id CHAR(32), 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lineage_tip_message_id CHAR(32), 
	lineage_tip_sequence BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	closed_at DATETIME, 
	retention_until DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, session_id), 
	CHECK (lineage_tip_sequence >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, session_key), 
	CHECK (retention_until >= updated_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, agent_id) REFERENCES agents (tenant_id, agent_id), 
	CHECK (revision >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (tenant_id, workspace_id), 
	CHECK (state IN ('created', 'active', 'waiting', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)
name: sessions

CREATE TABLE tenants (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	slug TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id),

	UNIQUE (slug)
)

definition:
CREATE TABLE transitions (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	transition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	from_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	to_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	transitioned_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, transition_id), 
	CHECK ((from_state = 'queued' AND to_state IN ('dispatched', 'cancelled')) OR (from_state = 'dispatched' AND to_state IN ('running', 'failed', 'cancelled')) OR (from_state = 'running' AND to_state IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled'))), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, command_id, sequence), 
	CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, command_id) REFERENCES commands (tenant_id, command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id)
)
name: transitions

CREATE TABLE users (

	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	subject TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	email TEXT, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, subject), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, email)
)
name: users

CREATE TABLE websocket_tickets (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	ticket_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	ticket_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	principal_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	principal_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	refresh_session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_key TEXT, 
	observer_scope JSON NOT NULL, 
	issued_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	retention_until DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, ticket_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, session_key) REFERENCES sessions (tenant_id, session_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, refresh_session_id) REFERENCES refresh_sessions (tenant_id, refresh_session_id), 
	CHECK (expires_at > issued_at), 
	CHECK (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= issued_at), 
	CHECK (retention_until >= expires_at), 
	CHECK (principal_type IN ('user', 'device', 'connector')), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, ticket_digest)
)
name: websocket_tickets

CREATE TABLE workspace_memberships (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_membership_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	joined_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, workspace_membership_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (tenant_id, workspace_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, workspace_id, user_id, role_id), 
	CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= joined_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (tenant_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'revoked')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (tenant_id, role_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES users (tenant_id, user_id)
)
name: workspace_memberships

CREATE TABLE workspaces (
	tenant_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	created_by CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
